advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Ṱalulani datumu dza garaṱa nga @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt kana @listEnteredAt. Tsumbo: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' kana @endAt = none. Vheani dzina ḽa tshipiḓa tsho itelwaho inwi ḽi thomaho nga @ kha zwiga zwa khoutheisheni.
advanced-filter-description: U ṱalula ha nṱha hu tendela u ṅwala maipfi a re na ndaela idzi: == != <= >= && || ( ) Tshikhala tshi fhambanya ndaela. Ni nga ṱalula fhethu hoṱhe ha data ho dzudzanywaho nga u ṅwala madzina na ndeme. Sa tsumbo: Field1 == Value1. Ṱhogomelani: Arali fhethu kana ndeme zwi na zwikhala, zwi vheeni vhukati ha zwiga zwa khotheisheni nthihi. Sa tsumbo: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. U pfuka zwiga zwa u langa (' \/), ni nga shumisa \. Sa tsumbo: Field1 == I\'m. Ni nga ṱanganya zwiimo zwinzhi. Sa tsumbo: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Nga misi ndaela dzi ṱalutshedzwa u bva kha tsha monde u ya kha tsha u ḽa. Ni nga shandula mutevhe nga zwitangeli. Sa tsumbo: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ni nga ṱoḓa fhethu ha maipfi nga regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

__admin__ o shumisa u swikelela ha shishi u dzhena sa __user__ kha __url__ nga __time__.

Tshiitisi: __note__

Zwoṱhe zwe zwa itwa nga tshenetsho tshifhinga zwi kha Phanele ya mulanguli / Vhathu / Rekhodo ya u ṱolwa na Vhuleme / Muvhigo wa u edzisa mushumisi.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Nambatedza Kanboard export JSON: tshithu tshi re na "columns" (kana mishumo i hwalaho column_name) na tshiṱaka "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns dzi vha mitevhe nahone mishumo i vha makhaḓi.
import-board-instruction-deck: Nambatedza NextCloud Deck board JSON (bodo ḽi re na "stacks", stack iṅwe na iṅwe i hwala "cards" dzayo). Stacks dzi vha mitevhe nahone makhaḓi a vha makhaḓi.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Nambatedza OpenProject work-packages collection JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses dzi vha mitevhe nahone work packages dzi vha makhaḓi.
import-board-instruction-issues: Nambatedza __sourceName__ issues JSON array (__endpoint__). Issues dzi vha makhaḓi o dzudzanywaho kha mitevhe ya Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Nambatedza Asana tasks export JSON ({ "data": [...] } u bva kha Asana export kana GET /tasks). Mishumo yo dzudzanywa kha zwipiḓa (memberships); mishumo yo fhelaho i ya kha Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Nambatedza ZenKit list export JSON ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages dzi vha mitevhe nahone items dzi vha makhaḓi.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Nambatedzani mutevhe wa mishumo wa markdown (nḓila ine zwishumiswa zwa markdown-kanban zwi ngaho Obsidian Kanban zwa i shumisa): ṱhoho dza "## Dzina ḽa mutevhe", na zwithu zwa "- [ ]"/"- [x]" fhasi hadzo. Ṱhoho dzi vha mitevhe nahone zwithu zwi vha makhadi; mutevhe wa zwithu u si na zwibogisi wo dzhenisiwa sa makhadi o vulwaho.
import-board-instruction-leo: Nambatedzani tshivhumbeo tsha Leo (faela ya .leo). Zwipiḓa zwa vhuimo ha nṱha zwi vha mitevhe, zwipiḓa zwi re fhasi hazwo thwii zwi vha garaṱa, nahone maṅwalwa a tshipiḓa a vha ṱhaluso ya garaṱa. Zwipiḓa zwa vhuimo ho dzikaho zwi vha mitevhe ya u ṱola. Zwipiḓa zwo swaiwaho zwi dzheniswa sa zwo fhedzwaho.
import-board-instruction-opml: Nambatedzani OPML outline, sa zwine Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq na zwiṅwe zwa outliner zwa i bvisela nnḓa. Zwithu zwa nṱha zwi vha mitevhe, vhana vhazwo vha vha khadi dzi re na noutu sa ṱhaluso, na zwithu zwa fhasi zwi vha mitevhe ya u sedza. Zwithu zwo fhelaho zwi dzheniswa sa zwo fhela.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Nambatedzani faela ya Org mode, sa zwine Emacs, Orgzly kana Beorg zwa i ṅwala. Ṱhoho dza nṱha dzi vha mitevhe na ṱhoho dza vhuvhili dzi vha khadi. TODO na DONE, ndeme, thegi, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE na CLOSED zwi a vhulungwa, na zwibogisi zwa u swaya na ṱhoho dza fhasi zwi vha mitevhe ya u sedza.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Nambatedzani faela ya todo.txt: mushumo muthihi kha mutaladzi muṅwe na muṅwe, sa zwine app ya todo.txt na app dzi tshimbilelanaho nayo zwa ṅwalisa zwone. Mishumo yo fhelaho ("x") i ya kha Yo fhela, +project na @context zwi vha dzilebulu, (A) i vha lebulu ya zwine zwa tea u thoma, ngeno due: na t: zwi tshi vha maḓuvha a u fhedza na a u thoma.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Nambatedzani mvelelo ya task export: mutevhe wa JSON, kana mushumo muthihi kha mutaladzi muṅwe na muṅwe. Mishumo yo fhelaho i ya kha Done, project na priority zwi shanduka zwa vha dziḽeibuḽu, annotations i shanduka ya vha mihumbulo, nahone depends i shanduka ya vha vhushaka ha u ḓitika nga mishumo ine ya khou thivhela uyu mushumo.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Vulani faela ya .boardarchive ni nambatedze board.jsonl ya bodo, i na mutaladzi wa nzudzanyo kana i si nawo. Tshivhumbeo tsha u kuvhanganya nga zwigwada kha mbonalo ya bodo tshi shanduka tsha vha mitevhe, zwiṅwe zwivhumbeo zwa u nanga zwi shanduka zwa vha dziḽeibuḽu, zwipiḓa zwa maṅwalwa na mabogisi a u maka zwi shanduka zwa vha ṱhaluso na mutevhe wa u ṱola, nahone mihumbulo a a vhulungwa. Zwifanyiso na zwiambataniswa a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-todoist: Kha Todoist, vulani phurodzheke, nangani menyu ya ⋯ i re nṱha kha tshauri, nga murahu Manage data > Export as CSV, ni nambatedze faela ya CSV. Zwipiḓa zwi vha mitevhe, mishumo i vha makhadi, mishumo miṱuku i vha mutevhe wa u sedza, zwiṱodzi zwi vha mihumbulo, nahone @labels na zwi ṱanganedzwaho u thoma p1 u swika p3 zwi vha dziḽeibuḽu.
import-board-instruction-planner: Kha Microsoft Planner, vulani pulane, nangani menyu ya ⋯ i re tsini na dzina ḽayo, nga murahu Export as Excel (kha Planner ya kale: Export plan to Excel), ni nange iyo faela ya .xlsx. Buckets dzi vha mitevhe nahone mishumo i vha makhadi, na vho avhelwaho mushumo, maḓuvha, dziḽeibuḽu, mutevhe wa u sedza na ṱhaluso zwazwo; Progress, Priority na Completed By zwi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho.
import-board-instruction-azuredevops: Kha Azure DevOps, vulani Boards, nga murahu Queries, shumisani query i sumbedzaho dzikholomu dze na dzi ṱoda, ni nange Export to CSV; nangani iyo faela ya .csv. Board Column (kana State) i vha mitevhe nahone Board Lane i vha dziḽaini; zwithu zwa mushumo zwi vha garaṱa na lushaka lwazwo na dzi-tag sa dziḽeibuḽu, Assigned To, maḓuvha, ṱhaluso na tshithu tsha mubebi, nahone dzikholomu dziṅwe dzi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho.
import-board-instruction-mslists: Kha Microsoft Lists, vulani mutevhe, nangani Export, nga murahu Export to CSV, ni nange iyo faela ya .csv. Kholomu ya Status (kana Progress) i vha mitevhe nahone tshithu tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshi vha garaṱa, na ḓina ḽatsho, ṱhaluso, vhathu, maḓuvha na dzi-tag; dzikholomu dziṅwe dzi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho.
import-board-instruction-msproject: Kha Microsoft Project, nangani File, nga murahu Save As, nga lushaka lwa XML Format (*.xml), ni nange iyo faela. Mishumo ya manweledzo i vha dziḽaini nahone mishumo i vha garaṱa kha Not started, In progress kana Completed, na maḓuvha ayo, zwiṅwalwa, zwiko, mishumo miṱuku na mishumo i ḓaho phanḓa.
import-board-instruction-outlook: Kha Outlook, kokodzani milaedza ni i ise kha foḽidara kha khomphyutha yaṋu, kana ni i vhulunge nga File, nga murahu Save As, sa Outlook Message Format (*.msg). Nangani faela nthihi ya .msg, kana .zip ya dzifaela dza .msg na .eml. Nyambedzano iṅwe na iṅwe i vha garaṱa kha Board View / Email, phindulo dzayo sa mahumbulwa na zwiṱumetshedzwa zwayo sa dzifaela.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Kha MeisterTask, kiḽikani dzina ḽa phurodzhege, nangani Export project ni bvisele nnḓa CSV, ni kone u i nambatedza. Zwipiḓa zwi vha mitevhe na mishumo i vha khadi, na noutu dzayo, ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza, o avhelwaho mushumo na thegi; mishumo yo fhelaho i vhulunga ḓuvha ḽa u fhela. CSV yo ṅwalelwaho u dzhenisa ha MeisterTask hone i a shuma.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Kha Obsidian, vulani faela ya bodo ya Kanban sa Markdown (kana ni vule faela ya .md kha editha ya maṅwalwa), ni kone u i nambatedza yoṱhe. Ḽaini dzi vha mitevhe na mikano ya khadi yadzo, khadi dzi vhulunga thegi dzadzo, maḓuvha, ndeme, fhethu na mutevhe wa u sedza, na Archive i vha khadi dzo iswaho fhethu ha u vhulunga.
import-board-instruction-linear: Kha Linear, bviselani nnḓa mafhungo sa CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, kana u bvisela nnḓa ha view), ni kone u nambatedza CSV. Zwiimo zwi vha mitevhe, thimu dzi vha ḽaini, na mafhungo a vha khadi na o avhelwaho mushumo, ḽeibuḽu, maḓuvha, mafhungo a vhubebi, ndeme, khakhathelo, phurodzhege na tshifhinga.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Kha TickTick, vulani Settings, Account, Backup & Import ni ite backup, ni kone u nambatedza faela ya CSV. Mutevhe muṅwe na muṅwe wa TickTick u vha ḽaini na kholomu dzawo dzi vha mitevhe; mishumo i vhulunga thegi dzayo, maḓuvha, mutevhe wa u sedza, ndeme na mishumo miṱuku.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Kha ClickUp, bviselani nnḓa mishumo sa CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, kana u bvisela nnḓa ha List kana Table view na kholomu dzoṱhe), ni kone u nambatedza CSV. Zwiimo zwi vha mitevhe, mitevhe ya ClickUp i vha ḽaini, na mishumo i vha khadi na mishumo miṱuku yayo, vho avhelwaho mushumo, thegi, maḓuvha, ndeme na tshifhinga.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Kha Nullboard, vulani bodo, nangani Export this board... kha menyu, vulani faela ya .nbx kha editha ya maṅwalwa ni nambatedze zwi re ngomu. Mitevhe i vha mitevhe na noutu dzi vha khadi: mutevhe wa u thoma wa noutu ndi ṱhoho ya khadi na zwo salaho ndi ṱhaluso yayo. Noutu ya raw i wana ḽeibuḽu raw. Faela i re na bodo nnzhi i dzhenisa bodo yayo ya u thoma.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Kha Kanri, vulani Import & Export ni nange Export individual board (kana Export all data), ni kone u nambatedza faela ya .json. Kholomu dzi vha mitevhe na khadi dzi vha khadi, na ṱhaluso yadzo, ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza, thegi na mivhala; mishumo ya khadi i vha mutevhe wa u sedza. Kha u bvisela nnḓa data yoṱhe ho dzheniswa bodo ya u thoma.
import-board-instruction-planka: Ṅwalani aḓirese ya Planka yaṋu (tsumbo https://planka.example.com), dzina ḽa mushumisi na phasiwede ya Planka, nga murahu ni putedze "Sumbedza mutevhe". Zwi shumiswa fhedzi u dzhia bodo nahone a zwi vhulungwi. Khethani bodo ni putedze "Dzhia": WeKan i i vhala u bva kha API ya Planka, khathihi na mitevhe, garaṱa, ṱhaluso, maḓuvha a u fhedza, zwiga, miraḓo, mitevhe ya mishumo na mihumbulo, nga murahu ni bvele phanḓa na u dzhenisa sa zwa ḓuvha na ḓuvha. Garaṱa dzi re fhethu ha u vhulunga ha Planka dzi dzheniswa dzo vhulungwa; zwo nambatedzwaho na garaṱa dzi re kha tshikwama tsha matshika a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Kha Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), dzhenani, tendelani thendelo ya Tasks.Read nahone ni kopolole token kha thebe ya Access token. I nambatedzeni fhano ni putedze "Sumbedza mutevhe"; token i shumiswa fhedzi kha u dzhia uhu nahone a i vhulungwi. Khethani mitevhe yoṱhe kana mutevhe muthihi ni putedze "Dzhia". Mutevhe muṅwe na muṅwe wa To Do u vha mutevhe nahone mushumo muṅwe na muṅwe u vha garaṱa, na zwiṅwalwa zwawo, maḓuvha a u fhedza na a u thoma, maga sa mutevhe wa u ṱola, zwigwada sa zwiga, ndeme ya nṱha na tshiimo sa zwiga; mishumo yo fhedzwaho i vhulungwa. Zwihumbudzi na u dovholola a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-onenote: Kha Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), dzhenani, tendelani thendelo ya Notes.Read nahone ni kopolole token kha thebe ya Access token. I nambatedzeni fhano ni putedze "Sumbedza mutevhe"; token i shumiswa fhedzi kha u dzhia uhu nahone a i vhulungwi. Khethani bugu ya zwiṅwalwa ni putedze "Dzhia". Zwipiḓa zwi vha mitevhe nahone masiaṱari a vha garaṱa, na maṅwalwa awo, zwibogisi zwa mishumo sa mutevhe wa u sedza na masiaṱari maṱuku sa mishumo miṱuku.
import-board-instruction-teams: Nambatedzani token ya u swikela ya Microsoft Graph i re na Chat.Read (u bva kha Graph Explorer, akhaunthu ya mushumo kana ya tshikolo) ni putedze "Sumbedza mutevhe", nga murahu ni nange chat kana channel ni putedze "Dzhia"; token a i vhulungwi. Kana nangani faela: .tar ya export yaṋu ya muthu nga eṱhe u bva kha teams.live.com/dataexport, kana .json ya milaedza ya chat. Chat iṅwe na iṅwe i vha garaṱa kha Board View / Chat, milaedza yayo i vha mahumbulwa.
import-board-instruction-sandstorm: Kha Sandstorm, vulani grain ya __app__, nangani “Download backup” kha bara ya nṱha ya grain, ni nange faela yeneyo ya .zip. Zwi re kha grain zwi vha bodo, zwithu zwayo zwi vha garaṱa na zwine app ya zwi vhulunga nga hazwo. Nangani app ine grain ya vha yayo: grain ya iṅwe app i a hanwa, nahone i amba uri ndi app ifhio.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Kha KanbanFlow, vulani menu ya bodo, khethani Settings → API & Webhooks nahone ni kopolole API token ya bodo. Nambatedzani token fhano, putedzani "Sumbedza mutevhe", khethani bodo ni putedze "Dzhia"; token i shumiswa fhedzi kha u dzhia uho nahone a i vhulungwi. Kholomu dzi vha mitevhe nahone nḓila dza mushumo dzi dzula dzi nḓila dza mushumo; mishumo i vhulunga ṱhaluso, muvhala, zwiga, ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza, mishumwana sa mutevhe wa u ṱola, tshifhinga tsho shumiswaho, khakhathelo, vhathu na mihumbulo.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Ṅwalani ID ya akhaunthu yaṋu ya Basecamp (nomboro i tevhelaho basecamp.com/ kha aḓirese) na token ya u swikelela (u bva kha app ya OAuth 2 yo ṅwaliswaho kha launchpad.37signals.com, kana ine ṱhanganyiso i re hone ya vha i nayo), putedzani "Sumbedza mutevhe", khethani thandela ni putedze "Dzhia". Token i shumiswa fhedzi kha u dzhia uho nahone a i vhulungwi. Ṱafula ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽa garaṱa ḽi vha nḓila ya mushumo ine kholomu dzayo dza vha mitevhe, nahone mitevhe ya zwine zwa tea u itwa i vha nḓila ya mushumo ya "To-dos"; garaṱa na zwine zwa tea u itwa zwi vhulunga maṅwalwa, maḓuvha, vho ṋewaho mushumo na mihumbulo, maga a garaṱa a vha mutevhe wa u ṱola, nahone zwo fhedzwaho zwi vhulungwa.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Wanani token ya u swikelela kha OAuth 2.0 Playground: fhasi ha Tasks API v1 khethani tasks.readonly, putedzani Authorize APIs, nga murahu Exchange authorization code for tokens, ni kopolole access token. I nambatedzeni fhano ni putedze "Sumbedza mutevhe", khethani mitevhe yoṱhe ya mishumo kana muthihi, nga murahu "Dzhia". Token i shumiswa fhedzi kha u dzhia uhu nahone a i vhulungwi. Mitevhe ya mishumo i vha mitevhe nahone mishumo i vha garaṱa, na zwiṅwalwa, vhukwamani na ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza; mishumwana i vha mutevhe wa u ṱola nahone mishumo yo fhedzwaho i dzheniswa yo vhulungwa.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API ya Google Keep ndi ya akhaunthu dza Google Workspace fhedzi. Wanani token ya u swikelela ya OAuth 2.0 i re na scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (kha OAuth 2.0 Playground arali mulanguli wa Workspace a tshi tendela, kana u bva kha service account i re na u rumela ha domain yoṱhe), i nambatedzeni, putedzani "Sumbedza mutevhe" nga murahu "Dzhia". Token i shumiswa fhedzi kha u dzhia uhu nahone a i vhulungwi. Zwiṅwalwa zwa maipfi zwi vha garaṱa kha mutevhe wa "Notes", nahone zwiṅwalwa zwa mutevhe wa u ṱola zwi vha garaṱa kha mutevhe wa "Lists" na zwithu zwazwo sa mutevhe wa u ṱola. Zwiṅwalwa zwi re kha matshika, zwo nambatedzwaho na u kovhekana a zwi dzheniswi.
api-import-desc: I dzhieni kha tshumelo nga akhaunthu yaṋu. Zwine na zwi ṅwala fhano zwi shumiswa fhedzi kha u dzhia uhu nahone a zwi vhulungwi.
api-import-fetched: Zwo dzhiiwa. Ṱolani miraḓo i re fhasi ni dzhenise.
api-import-nothing: A hu na tshithu tsha u dzhenisa nga akhaunthu iyi.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Kha Pivotal Tracker, vulani thebu ya MORE ya phurodzhege ni nange Export CSV (kana ni nange story ni nange Bulk Actions, CSV), ni kone u nambatedza CSV. Tshiimo tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsha story tshi vha mutevhe na story dzi vha khadi, na lushaka lwadzo na ḽeibuḽu, vhaṋe, muṱoḓi, maḓuvha, mihumbulo, mishumo na zwithivheli; Estimate i vha Story points na iteration dzi vha sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Kha Tasks.org, vulani Settings, Backups ni nange Export tasks, ni kone u nambatedza zwi re ngomu ha faela iyo ya .json. Mitevhe i vha mitevhe na mishumo i vha khadi, na noutu dzayo, thegi, maḓuvha, mihumbulo na mishumo miṱuku; mishumo yo fhelaho i vhulunga ḓuvha ḽa u fhela, na ndeme i vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho.
import-board-instruction-monday: Kha monday.com, vulani menyu wa bodo, nangani More actions na Export board to Excel (na updates na subitems arali ni tshi ṱoḓa), ni kone u nanga faela iyo ya .xlsx. Kholomu ya Status i vha mitevhe na zwigwada zwi vha ḽaini; vhathu, maḓuvha, timeline na thegi zwi dzula fhethu hazwo, kholomu dziṅwe dzi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho na updates dzi vha mihumbulo.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Kha Super Productivity, vulani Settings, nga murahu Sync & Backup, nangani Export Data ni nambatedze zwi re ngomu ha faela ya sp-backup .json. Phurodzhege iṅwe na iṅwe i vha ḽaini na mishumo i vha khadi kha To Do, In Progress, Backlog kana Done, na noutu dzayo, thegi, ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza, tshifhinga tsho shumiswaho na mishumo miṱuku; mishumo yo iswaho fhethu ha u vhulunga i vha khadi dzo iswaho fhethu ha u vhulunga.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Kha Taiga, vulani Admin > Project > Export ni dauniḽoude dump ya phurodzhege (bvulani faela ya .json.gz u thoma), ni kone u nambatedza JSON yayo. Zwiimo zwa user story zwi vha mitevhe, user story dzi vha khadi na mishumo yadzo sa mishumo miṱuku, epic na mafhungo zwi wana ḽaini dzazwo, na sprint, thegi, mihumbulo na custom attributes zwi ḓa nazwo. Zwiṱumetshedzwa a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Kha Vikunja, vulani Settings, nangani Data Export ni dauniḽoude faela ya .zip ine ya ni rumela yone, ni kone u nanga faela iyo, kana ni nambatedze data.json i re ngomu hayo. Kanban bucket dzi vha mitevhe na mishumo i vha khadi, na ḽeibuḽu dzayo, vho avhelwaho mushumo, maḓuvha, ṱhaluso, mitevhe ya mishumo sa mitevhe ya u sedza na mihumbulo; ndeme, phesenthe yo fhelaho na done zwi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho. Zwiṱumetshedzwa a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-quire: Kha Quire, vulani menyu wa phurodzhege ni nange Export CSV, ni kone u nambatedza CSV. Zwiimo zwi vha mitevhe na mishumo i vha khadi, na mishumo miṱuku yayo sa khadi dza vhana, vho avhelwaho mushumo, thegi sa ḽeibuḽu, maḓuvha a u thoma, a u fhedza na a u fhela, ṱhaluso na ndeme sa fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho. Mihumbulo na zwiṱumetshedzwa a zwi kha CSV ya Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Kha Wrike, bviselani nnḓa phurodzhege kana fodara kha Excel, kana ni ḓadze themphuḽeithi ya Excel ya u dzhenisa ya Wrike, ni kone u nanga faela iyo ya .xlsx. Mitevhe ya fodara na phurodzhege i vha ḽaini, Status i vha mitevhe na mishumo i vha khadi, na Key yayo, mushumo wa vhubebi, vho avhelwaho mushumo, maḓuvha a u thoma na a u fhela, zwi tshi ḓitika na ṱhaluso; Priority, Duration na kholomu dziṅwe dzi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Kha Teamwork.com, ḓadzani themphuḽeithi ya Excel ya u dzhenisa mishumo (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ni i vhulunge sa .xlsx, ni kone u nanga faela iyo. Mitevhe ya mishumo i vha mitevhe na mishumo i vha khadi; mushumo u thomaho nga -, # kana > u vha mushumo muṱuku wa mushumo u re nṱha hawo (--, ## kana >> vhuimo vhuthihi fhasi). Vho avhelwaho mushumo, maḓuvha na thegi zwi dzula fhethu hazwo; Priority, Estimated time na Complete zwi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Kha Businessmap (ḽine ḽa vha Kanbanize kale), vulani Advanced Search, nangani Configure results u nanga kholomu, dauniḽodani faela ya Excel, ni kone u nanga faela iyo ya .xlsx. Kholomu dzi vhalwa nga madzina adzo a Luisimane (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): arali akhaunthu yaṋu i tshi shumisa luṅwe luambo, shandukisani madzina a mutevhe wa ṱhoho a vhe nga Luisimane u thoma. Column i vha mitevhe na Lane i vha ḽaini; vhaṋe, thegi, muvhala, maḓuvha, mihumbulo na linki dza vhubebi zwi dzula fhethu hazwo, na Priority, Size, Type na kholomu dziṅwe zwi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Kha Redmine, vulani Issues dza phurodzhege, nangani Also available in: CSV fhasi ha mutevhe, nangani kholomu (All columns, na Description) ni bvisele nnḓa, ni kone u nambatedza CSV. Redmine i ṋea kholomu madzina nga luambo lwaṋu, nga zwenezwo vhewani luambo lwaṋu lu vhe Luisimane kha My account ni sa athu bvisela nnḓa. Tshiimo tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshi vha mutevhe na mafhungo a vha khadi, na tracker sa ḽeibuḽu, o avhelwaho mushumo, muṅwali, maḓuvha, mushumo wa vhubebi na mafhungo a elanaho; ndeme, khethekanyo, vesheni ye ya livhiswa, tshifhinga tsho khakhathelwaho, % Done na fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho zwi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho.
import-board-instruction-notion: Kha Notion, vulani database sa siaṱari ḽoṱhe, nangani ••• na Export, nangani Markdown & CSV, ni nange faela ya .zip ine ya dauniḽouda, kana database CSV nthihi u bva khayo, kana ni nambatedze CSV iyo. Kholomu i re na dzina ḽa Status i vha mitevhe (arali i siho, kholomu ya u thoma i vhonalaho sa select i a ita zwenezwo, na muvhigo wa u dzhenisa u amba uri ndi ifhio); mitevhe i vha khadi na ṱhoho yadzo, thegi sa ḽeibuḽu, vhathu sa miraḓo, maḓuvha, na maṅwalwa a siaṱari sa ṱhaluso; kholomu dziṅwe dzi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho. Vhushaka, zwifanyiso na zwiṱumetshedzwa a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-plane: Kha Plane, vulani Workspace Settings, nangani Exports, bviselani nnḓa phurodzhege sa JSON, CSV kana Excel ni dauniḽoude faela ya .zip, ni kone u nanga faela iyo, kana faela nthihi u bva ngomu hayo, kana ni nambatedze JSON kana CSV. Zwiimo zwi vha mitevhe, phurodzhege dzi vha ḽaini, na mafhungo a vha khadi na tshiṱalusi tshayo, vhubebi, vho avhelwaho mushumo, ḽeibuḽu, maḓuvha, linki na mihumbulo; ndeme, khakhathelo, cycle na module zwi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho. U bvisela nnḓa ha Plane a hu na ṱhaluso kana zwiṱumetshedzwa, nga zwenezwo a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-fizzy: Kha Fizzy, bviselani nnḓa akhaunthu kha “Account settings”, kana garaṱa dzaṋu nga “Download my data”, ni nange faela ya .zip ine Fizzy ya ni rumela yone, kana faela ya .json ya garaṱa nthihi. Dzibodo dzi ḓo vha dziḽaini nahone dzikholomu dzi ḓo vha mitevhe, na “Maybe?”, “Not now” na “Done” sa kha Fizzy; garaṱa dzi vhulunga ṱhaluso yadzo, dzithegi, vho avhelwaho mushumo, zwiṱepe sa mutevhe wa u ṱola, mahumbulwa na dzifaela.
import-board-instruction-mail: Nangani faela ya .mbox, sa zwine Thunderbird, Apple Mail, mutt kana Gmail nga Google Takeout zwa i vhulunga zwone, kana mulaedza muthihi wa .eml, kana ni nambatedze maipfi ayo. Nyambedzano iṅwe na iṅwe i ḓo vha khadi nthihi kha mutevhe wa Inbox, na murumeli wayo, vhatanganedzi na thoho yayo, uri i vhonale kha mbonalo ya Email; phindulo dzi ḓo vha mahumbulwa ayo. Dziḽeibuḽu dza Gmail dzi ḓo vha dziḽeibuḽu. Zwiṱumetshedzwa a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-ical: Nangani faela ya khalenda ya .ics, sa zwine Google Calendar, Apple Calendar kana Reminders, Thunderbird, Nextcloud kana Outlook zwa i bvisela nnḓa zwone, kana ni nambatedze maipfi ayo. Mishumo i ya kha To Do, In Progress, Done kana Cancelled u ya nga vhuimo hayo, na zwiitea kha Events, na maḓuvha a u thoma na a u fhedza, uri zwi vhonale kha mbonalo dza Calendar na Gantt. Khethekanyo na ndeme dzi ḓo vha dziḽeibuḽu. Zwithu zwi dovhololwaho zwi dzheniswa luthihi fhedzi.
import-board-instruction-googletakeout: Kha takeout.google.com, nangani Tasks, Keep, Mail, Calendar na Google Chat, itani u bvisela nnḓa ni dawunulode faela ya .zip, nga murahu ni i nange fhano. Bindu ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽi ḓo vha ḽiḽaini: poswo ya mbonalo ya Email, mitevhe ya mishumo na zwiṅwalwa na mitevhe yazwo ya u sedza, zwiitea zwa khalenda na mishumo na maḓuvha, na fhethu ha nyambedzano hune milaedza yaho ya vha mahumbulwa a mbonalo ya Chat. Mabindu maṅwe na zwiṱumetshedzwa a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-slack: Kha Slack, vulani mavhekanyele a fhethu ha mushumo, nangani Import/Export Data, bviselani fhethu ha mushumo nnḓa ni dawunulode faela ya .zip, nga murahu ni i nange fhano. Tshanele iṅwe na iṅwe i ḓo vha khadi kha Channels, Groups kana Direct messages, nahone milaedza yayo na phindulo dza thread dzi ḓo vha mahumbulwa a khadi, u ya nga muṅwali wadzo, uri mbonalo ya Chat i sumbedze tshanele. Faela a dzi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-mattermost: Bviselani nnḓa nga mmctl export create, dawunulodani zwo bviselwaho nnḓa ni nange faela yazwo ya .jsonl, kana ni nambatedze maipfi ayo. Tshanele iṅwe na iṅwe na mulaedza wa ndavhuko zwi ḓo vha khadi, nahone zwo rumelwaho na phindulo zwi ḓo vha mahumbulwa a khadi, uri mbonalo ya Chat i sumbedze tshanele. Zwigwada zwi ḓo vha dziḽaini. Faela a dzi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-telegram: Kha Telegram Desktop, vulani Settings, Advanced, Export Telegram data, nangani fomathe ya JSON ni bvisele nnḓa, nga murahu ni nange faela ya result.json, kana ni nambatedze maipfi ayo. Nyambedzano iṅwe na iṅwe i ḓo vha khadi kha Direct messages, Groups kana Channels, nahone milaedza yayo i ḓo vha mahumbulwa a khadi, uri mbonalo ya Chat i sumbedze nyambedzano. Zwifanyiso na faela a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-whatsapp: Kha WhatsApp, vulani nyambedzano, nangani Export chat i si na midia, ni nange faela ya .txt fhano, kana ni nambatedze maipfi ayo. Nyambedzano i ḓo vha khadi ine milaedza yayo ya vha mahumbulwa ayo, u ya nga murumeli na tshifhinga, uri mbonalo ya Chat i i sumbedze. Midia na milaedza ya sisiṱeme a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-discord: Bviselani nnḓa tshanele ya Discord nga DiscordChatExporter nga fomathe ya JSON ni nange faela ya .json, kana ni nambatedze maipfi ayo. Tshanele i ḓo vha khadi kha khethekanyo yayo, nahone milaedza yayo i ḓo vha mahumbulwa a khadi, uri mbonalo ya Chat i sumbedze tshanele. Seva i ḓo vha ḽiḽaini. Zwiṱumetshedzwa a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-rocketchat: Kha Rocket.Chat, bviselani nnḓa data yaṋu sa JSON kha “My Data” ni nange faela ya .zip ine ya ni rumela yone, kana faela ya .json yo bviselwaho nnḓa ya rumu nthihi. Rumu iṅwe na iṅwe i ḓo vha garaṱa nahone milaedza yayo i ḓo vha mahumbulwa a garaṱa, uri mbonalo ya Chat i sumbedze rumu. Na .zip ine WeKan ya i bvisela nnḓa u itela tshidzhenisi tsha CSV tsha Rocket.Chat i a vhaliwa.
import-board-instruction-evernote: Kha Evernote, bviselani nnḓa zwiṅwalwa kana bugu ya zwiṅwalwa sa faela ya .enex ni i nange fhano, kana ni nambatedze maipfi ayo. Tshiṅwalwa tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshi ḓo vha khadi na maipfi atsho, mabogisi atsho a zwine zwa fanela u itwa sa mutevhe wa u sedza, thege dzatsho sa dziḽeibuḽu na khumbudzo yatsho sa ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza; zwiṅwalwa zwine khumbudzo yazwo yo fhela zwi ya kha Done. Zwifanyiso na faela dzo ṱumanywaho a zwi dzheniswi.
tool-group-issues: Zwitevhedzi zwa thaidzo na ndaulo ya vesheni
tool-group-tasks: Apuḽikheisheni dza mishumo na zwine zwa tea u itwa
report-no-due-date: A hu na ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza
report-average-days-late: Maḓuvha a u lenga a vhukati
import-board-instruction-trello: Kha bodo yaṋu ya Trello, iyani kha 'Menu', nga murahu 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', ni kope maipfi o bviswaho.
import-board-instruction-csv: Nambatedzani ndeme dzaṋu dzo fhambanywaho nga khoma (CSV)/thebe (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Nambatedzani JSON ya u ṱoḓa mafhungo kha Jira Cloud: GET /rest/api/3/search/jql?jql=project=KEY&fields=*all&expand=names,schema (hu si na fields i vhuisa ID dza mafhungo fhedzi). Phurodzhege khulwane i ḓa nga masiaṱari, ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽi na nextPageToken ya siaṱari ḽi tevhelaho: vhewani mafhungo a masiaṱari oṱhe kha array nthihi ya "issues", kana ni dzhenise siaṱari ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe sa bodo yaḽo nga Dzhenisa bodo nnzhi. Tshithu tshi eḓanaho { "issues": [...] } na tshone tshi a shuma. Zwiimo zwa Jira zwi vha mitevhe nahone mafhungo a vha makhadi. Arali ni tshi ṱoḓa, katelani array ya "automationRules" u itela u dzhenisa milayo.
import-board-instruction-excel: Nangani bugu ya mushumo ya .xlsx: thebuḽu i re na khadi nthihi kha mutaladzi muṅwe na muṅwe (kholomu dzi ngaho Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, maḓuvha na fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho), kana bugu ya mushumo yo bviselwaho nnḓa nga WeKan, na i re na bodo iṅwe na iṅwe kha shithi yayo. Tshiṱepe tshi tevhelaho tshi sumbedza uri kholomu ifhio ndi fhethu hufhio. Shithi iṅwe na iṅwe i re na mutaladzi wa ṱhoho i vha bodo.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Kha bodo yaṋu ya Kanban, iyani kha 'Menu', nga murahu 'Export board', ni kope maipfi a faela yo dauniloudiwaho.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Arali ni wana vhukhakhi musi ni tshi dzhenisa bodo ya Kanban, nga zwiṅwe zwifhinga u dzhenisa hu kha ḓi shuma nahone bodo i vha kha siaṱari ḽa Bodo dzoṱhe.
import-without-mapping-members: Dzhenisa hu si na u mepa miraḓo (mepa nga murahu)
import-members-mode-map: Nangani mushumisi o no vhaho kha muṅwe na muṅwe wavho
import-members-mode-placeholder: Vha vhulungeni sa vhashumisi vha fhethu na madzina avho, u vha ṱumanya na vhashumisi vha vhukuma nga murahu
import-members-mode-me: Vha iteni vhoṱhe vha vhe nṋe
csv-mapping-description: Nangani kholomu ya faela i farelaho fhethu huṅwe na huṅwe ha khadi. Khetho dzo itwa u bva kha madzina a kholomu; shandukisani dziṅwe dzi re na vhukhakhi, ni nange (not in the file) kha fhethu hu si kho kha faela.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Faela a i na kholomu ya mutevhe. Nangani nthihi nṱha, kana ni ṅwale dzina ḽa mutevhe muthihi une khadi iṅwe na iṅwe ya ya khawo.
csv-mapping-list-name: Mutevhe wa khadi iṅwe na iṅwe
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Kholomu dziṅwe dza u dzhenisa sa fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho ha maṅwalwa:
csv-mapping-boards: Shithi iṅwe na iṅwe i vha bodo yayo:
csv-mapping-title-required: Nangani kholomu i farelaho ṱhoho dza khadi.
csv-mapping-list-required: Ṅwalani dzina ḽa mutevhe une khadi iṅwe na iṅwe ya ya khawo, kana ni nange kholomu i farelaho mutevhe.
invalid-import-mapping: U ṱumanya kholomu a zwi tendelani na faela.
import-many-boards-hint: Nangani faela nnzhi dza u bvisela nnḓa dza tshishumiswa itshi, kana .zip nthihi i dzi farelaho: faela iṅwe na iṅwe i vha bodo yayo, yo dzheniswaho hu si na u ṱumanya miraḓo. .zip ine ya vha u bvisela nnḓa huthihi (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, kana WeKan na zwiṱumetshedzwa) ndi bodo nthihi. Musi faela dzo nangwa fhano, Import i dzi dzhenisa nṱhani ha fhethu ha nṱha.
import-one-board-per-project: Bodo nthihi kha phurodzhege iṅwe na iṅwe
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Ḽaini iṅwe na iṅwe ine u dzhenisa ha nga i ita (phurodzhege, fodara kana mutevhe wa tshishumiswa) i vha bodo yayo. Khadi dza vhubebi na zwi ḓitikaho vhukati ha bodo idzo zwo ṅwalwa kha muvhigo wa u dzhenisa.
export-all-boards-hint: Bodo iṅwe na iṅwe ine na kona u i bvisela nnḓa, kha u dauniḽouda huthihi: Excel sa bugu ya mushumo nthihi i re na shithi kha bodo iṅwe na iṅwe yo ṋewaho dzina ḽayo, fomati iṅwe na iṅwe sa .zip i re na faela kha bodo iṅwe na iṅwe.

import-csv-placeholder: Nambatedzani data yaṋu yo teaho ya CSV/TSV afha
import-json-file: Kana nangani faela ya Trello JSON
import-attachments-zip: ZIP ya zwiṱumetshedzwa zwa Trello (a i ṱhogei, u bva kha Trello Card Attachments Downloader)
import-trello-json-file-hint: Bodo nthihi ya Trello yo bviselwaho nnḓa sa .json. Arali no vhulunga khiyi ya API na thokheni ya Trello, zwiṱumetshedzwa zwayo, tshifanyiso tsha murahu tsha bodo na zwifanyiso zwa miraḓo na zwone zwi a dauniḽoudiwa.
import-trello-zip-file-hint: Faela ya .zip i re na faela nthihi kana nnzhi dza bodo dza .json na zwiṱumetshedzwa zwadzo kha dzifoḽidara dza madzina a bodo (u bva kha Trello Card Attachments Downloader). Bodo dzoṱhe dzi a dzheniswa.
import-trello-zip-no-boards: A hu na faela dza bodo dza Trello .json dzo wanwaho kha .zip.
import-trello-zip-progress: Hu khou dzheniswa mabodo u bva kha .zip, ni humbelwa u lindela…
import-trello-failed: U dzhenisa u bva kha Trello zwo kundelwa.
import-timeout: U dzhenisa ho dzhia tshifhinga tshihulu vhukuma nahone ho imiswa. Kha vha lingedze hafhu; arali zwi tshi bvela phanḓa, bodo i nga vha khulu vhukuma kana database i khou shuma vhukuma.
import-too-large: Faela ndi khulwane vhukuma u nga dzheniswa nga tshifhinga tshithihi. I khethekanyeni i vhe dzifaela ṱhukhu, sa tsumbo nga phurodzhekiṱe kana nga ḓuvha, ni dzhenise iṅwe na iṅwe.
import-trello-zip-read-failed: A zwo konadzea u vhala .zip yo layishwaho.
import-trello-zip-too-large: Iyi .zip ndi khulwane vhukuma uri i dzheniswe.
import-trello-zip-too-many-files: Iyi .zip i na faela nnzhi vhukuma uri dzi dzheniswe.
import-trello-zip-file-too-large: Faela nthihi ngomu kha .zip ndi khulwane vhukuma uri i dzheniswe.
import-trello-zip-unsafe-path: Iyi .zip i na dziṋḓila dza faela dzi si na tsireledzo nahone yo hanelwa.
import-trello-workspace: Dzina ḽa fhethu ha mushumo ha muṋe (a ḽi ṱhogei)
import-attachment-auth-hint: U bvisela nnḓa hu bula madzina a zwiṱumetshedzwa zwaho fhedzi a hu hwali faela. U dzi ḓisa, ṋekedzani diresi ya tshumelo na u dzhena: zwi shumiswa kha u dzhenisa hoyu fhedzi, zwi rumelwa kha diresi iyo fhedzi, nahone a zwi vhulungwi na luthihi. Litshani ho sala hu si na tshithu u dzhenisa hu si na faela.
import-attachment-auth-token: Thokheni ya API, khiyi ya API kana phasiwede ya app
import-trello-workspace-placeholder: Bodo yo dzheniswaho i vhewa fhasi ha fhethu uhu ha mushumo, ho sikwaho arali ho vha hu si hone
import-trello-parent-workspace: Vhea fhethu ha mushumo ho dzheniswaho fhasi ha
trello-api-import: Dzhenisa u bva kha Trello nga khiyi ya API na thokheni
trello-api-import-desc: Nambatedzani khiyi ya API na thokheni ya Trello u itela u sumbedza fhethu ha mushumo na bodo zwaṋu zwa Trello, nga murahu ni dzhenise dzo nangwaho na zwiṱumetshedzwa zwadzo.
trello-api-key: Khiyi ya API ya Trello (u bva kha https://trello.com/app-key)
trello-api-token: Thokheni ya API ya Trello (yo bveledzwaho nga tshanḓa fhasi ha khiyi ya API)
trello-list-workspaces: Sumbedza fhethu ha mushumo ha Trello
trello-api-credentials-required: Ni humbelwa u dzhenisa khiyi ya API na thokheni ya Trello zwoṱhe.
trello-api-credentials-saved: Khiyi ya API na thokheni ya Trello zwo vhulungwa. Ni nga sumbedza fhethu ha mushumo ni sa tsha zwi dzhenisa hafhu.
trello-export-desc: Itani kopi ya bodo iyi kha Trello nga API ya Trello, nga khiyi ya API na thokheni yaṋu ya Trello. Ḽaini dzi vha ḽeibuḽu dzi re na dzina "Swimlane: …", dzine u dzhenisa ha Trello ha WeKan ha dzi vhuisa dza vha ḽaini.
trello-export-warnings: A si zwoṱhe zwo kona u bviselwa nnḓa
sandstorm-trello-access-needed: Grain ya Sandstorm a i na u swikela Inthanethe yayo. Tendelani grain iyi u swikela Trello u thoma.
sandstorm-trello-access-granted: Grain iyi i nga swikela Trello.

import-members-map: Bodo ya Kanban yo dzheniswaho i na miraḓo. Fanyisani miraḓo ine na ṱoḓa u i dzhenisa na vhashumisi vhaṋu

shared-labels-desc: Dziḽeibuḽu dzo vhulungwaho fhano dzi nga shumiswa kha mabodo manzhi, tsini na dziḽeibuḽu dza bodo iṅwe na iṅwe. U shandukisa dzina kana muvhala wa ḽiṅwe fhano zwi ḽi shandukisa kha bodo iṅwe na iṅwe i ḽi shumisaho; u bvisa ḽiṅwe zwi ḽi sia kha eneo mabodo sa ḽeibuḽu ḽavho.

list-select-cards: Nangani makhadi oṱhe a mutevhe uyu

passkeys-description: Khiyi ya u dzhena i ni tendela u dzhena nga tshivhumbeo tsha munwe, tshifhaṱuwo, khiyi ya skrini kana khiyi ya tsireledzo ya tshishumiswa itshi, hu si nga phasiwede yaṋu. I dzula kha tshishumiswa tshaṋu; WeKan i vhulunga khiyi yayo ya tshitshavha fhedzi.

passkey-add: Engedzani khiyi ya u dzhena kha tshishumiswa itshi
passkeys-unsupported: Buraweza iyi a i koni u ita khiyi dza u dzhena.

r-wrike-workflow-note: Maitele a mushumo a Wrike ndi mutevhe wa zwiimo, tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe kha tshigwada tsha Active, Completed, Deferred kana Cancelled. U bvisela nnḓa hu ṅwala mitevhe ya bodo iyi sa maitele maṱhihi, o ṋewaho dzina ḽa bodo, kha JSON ine API ya Wrike ya i vhuisa kha maitele a mushumo: sikani maitele ayo kha Wrike ni sa athu dzhenisa faela ya Excel ya bodo yo bviselwaho nnḓa u bva kha Wrike, uri zwiimo zwayo zwi shumiswe. U dzhenisa hu vhala JSON iyo yo nambatedzwaho nṱha, u bva kha WeKan kana kha GET /workflows ya Wrike, kha bodo yo nangwaho: tshiimo tshi si na mutevhe tshi vha mutevhe, nahone mulayo u swaya khadi sa ḽo fhela musi ḽi tshi pfuluselwa kha tshiimo tsha Completed kana Cancelled, na sa ḽi songo fhela kha tsha Active kana Deferred. Milayo ya Wrike ya u ḓiitela zwithu a i koni u bviselwa nnḓa u bva kha Wrike.

globalSearch-instructions-description: U ṱoḓa hu nga katela maipfi a ndaela u ṱalula zwine zwa ṱoḓiwa. Ṅwalani dzina ḽa ndaela na ndeme zwi tshi fhambanywa nga kholoni. Sa tsumbo, `list:Blocked` i ṱoḓa makhadi kha mutevhe une dzina ḽawo ḽa vha *Blocked*. Arali ndeme i na zwikhala kana zwiga zwo khetheaho, i fanela u vha vhukati ha zwiga zwa khotheisheni (sa `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - makhadi kha bodo dza Kanban dzi elanaho na *<title>* yo ṅwalwaho
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - makhadi kha mitevhe i elanaho na *<title>* yo ṅwalwaho
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - makhadi kha dziḽaini dzi elanaho na *<title>* yo ṅwalwaho
globalSearch-instructions-operator-comme: `__operator_comment__:<text>` - makhadi a re na muhumbulo u re na *<text>*.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - makhadi a re na ḽeibuḽu i elanaho na *<color>* kana *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-user: `__operator_user__:<username>` - makhadi ane *<username>* a vha *muraḓo* kana *o avhelwa mushumo* wao
globalSearch-instructions-operator-assig: `__operator_assignee__:<username>` - makhadi ane *<username>* a vha o avhelwa mushumo wao
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - makhadi ane *<username>* a vha musiki wao
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - makhadi a bodo ya Kanban yo avhelwaho dzangano *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - makhadi a bodo ya Kanban yo avhelwaho tshigwada *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - makhadi a fanela u fhedzwa hu sa athu fhira maḓuvha a *<n>* u bva zwino. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ i tevhekanya makhadi oṱhe o fhiraho ḓuvha ḽa u fhedzwa.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - makhadi o sikwaho maḓuvha a *<n>* o fhiraho kana a si gathi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - makhadi o shandulwaho maḓuvha a *<n>* o fhiraho kana a si gathi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - hune *<status>* ya vha iṅwe ya zwi tevhelaho:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - makhadi oṱhe o vhulungwaho na a sa athu vhulungwa
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: `__predicate_ended__` - makhadi a re na ḓuvha ḽa u guma
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - makhadi kha bodo dza Kanban dza nnyi na nnyi fhedzi
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - makhadi kha bodo dza Kanban dza tshiphiri fhedzi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - hune *<field>* ya vha iṅwe ya `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` kana `__predicate_member__`. U vhea `-` phanḓa ha *<field>* hu ṱoḓa u sa vha na ndeme kha fhethu honoho (sa `has:-due` i ṱoḓa makhadi a si na ḓuvha ḽa u fhedzwa).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - hune *<sort-name>* ya vha iṅwe ya `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` kana `__predicate_modified__`. U dzudzanya u bva nṱha u ya fhasi, vheani `-` phanḓa ha dzina ḽa u dzudzanya.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - hune *<n>* ya vha nomboro yo fhelelaho i re nṱha ha zero i sumbedzaho tshivhalo tsha makhadi a u sumbedza kha siaṱari ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Ndaela dzi fanaho dzi ṱanganywa nga *OR* (kana). Hu ḓo bviswa makhadi ane a tevhela tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsha zwiimo.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` i bvisa makhadi kha mutevhe une dzina ḽawo ḽa vha *Blocked* kana *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Ndaela dzi sa fani dzi ṱanganywa nga *AND* (na). Hu bviswa fhedzi makhadi ane a tevhela zwiimo zwoṱhe. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` i bvisa fhedzi makhadi kha mutevhe *Available* a re na ḽeibuḽu *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Maḓuvha a nga ṅwalwa sa nomboro yo fhelelaho i re nṱha kana fhasi ha zero, kana nga `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` kana `__predicate_year__` kha tshifhinga tsha zwino.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: U ṱoḓa maipfi a hu sedzi vhuhulwane ha maḽeḓere.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Nga nḓila ya u thoma, makhadi o vhulungwaho ha ṱoḓiwi.

mongodb-compact-description: Nga murahu ha u pfukisela faela u bva kha MongoDB GridFS, faela ya database kha disiki a i tsheneli nga u aṱo. U shumisa Compact zwi humisa tshikhala tsho vhofhololwaho nga u ṅwala hafhu data ya collection. Shumisa hezwi fhedzi nga murahu ha musi u pfukisa faela nnzhi ho fhela.
mongodb-compact-warning: Ṱhogomela: Compact ndi mushumo u thivhelaho une wa nga dzhia mineti minzhi kha database khulwane. Kha replica sets, secondaries dzoṱhe dzi compactiwa u thoma (nga u aṱo), nga zwenezwo primary. Kha single-node replica sets dzi shumiselwaho oplog (Meteor setup i ḓoweleaho), ndi primary fhedzi ine ya compactiwa.

password-length-report-desc: Akhaunthi dzo dzhenaho nga phasiwede pfufhi u fhira vhulapfu ha fhasi. Ndi burausa fhedzi i ḓivhaho uri phasiwede yo lapfa hani, ngauralo i vhiga phasiwede pfufhi musi ho dzhenwa; phasiwede na vhulapfu hayo a zwi bvi kha yone. Yo lugiswa ndi musi phasiwede ya akhaunthi yo shandulwa - akhaunthi i dzhenaho hafhu nga phasiwede pfufhi i sumbedzwa hafhu i pfufhi vhukuma.
password-length-filter-fixed: Yo lugiswa nga phasiwede yo lapfaho zwo linganaho
password-min-length-description: U dzhena nga phasiwede pfufhi hu ṅwalwa afho fhasi. U dzhena a hu hanwi nga ṅwambo uyu.

U i shandula zwi bvisa sesheni dzoṱhe dza akhaunthi. Phasiwede dza LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS na Sandstorm ndi dza vhaṋetshedzi vhadzo, nahone a dzi ṱolwi.

password-change-required-text: Iyi saithi zwino i ṱoḓa phasiwede dza zwiṅwalwa __min__ kana u fhira, nahone yaṋu yo pfufhi. Nangani yo lapfaho uri ni bvele phanḓa. Nga murahu sesheni dzoṱhe dza akhaunthi yaṋu dzi a bviswa, nahone ni dzhena hafhu nga phasiwede ntswa.

s3-sse-description: S3 i khouda zwoṱhe zwo nambatedzwaho, zwifanyiso zwa mushumisi na bakapu zwine WeKan ya zwi ṅwala, nahone i zwi bvisa khoudu kha WeKan musi zwi tshi vhalwa.

azure-connection-string-description: A zwi ṱhogei: shumisa connection string yo fhelelaho u fhira dzina ḽa akhaunthi na khii.
database-migration-description: Pfulusela data ya maṅwalwa (zwoṱhe nga nnḓa ha zwo namaṱheliswaho na avatar, zwine zwa sala kha filesystem) vhukati ha MongoDB na FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Iṅwe database i tea u vha i tshi khou shuma nahone i tshi swikelelwa (maphothi a tshiṱalula: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; shandula nga WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Nga murahu ha musi ho fhela, sedzisa MONGO_URL kha iṅwe database nahone thoma hafhu WeKan (kha Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb kana =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Pfulusela data ya maṅwalwa kha FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migrate-to-mongodb: Pfulusela data ya maṅwalwa kha MongoDB
database-migration-confirm: Kopa collections dzoṱhe dza maṅwalwa kha __db__? Zwo namaṱheliswaho na avatar kha filesystem a zwi kwamei. Database ya u swikela i tea u vha i tshi khou shuma.
database-migration-done: U pfulusela data ya maṅwalwa ho fhela.
sandstorm-migration-description: Musi WeKan i tshi shuma ngomu kha Sandstorm grain, database yayo ya kale ya MongoDB 3 i pfuluselwa kha FerretDB v1 (SQLite) kha u thoma u vulwa, nahone zwo namaṱheliswaho na avatar zwi pfuluselwa u bva kha database zwi ya kha thumba dza grain dza files/attachments na files/avatars. Hezwi zwi sumbedza arali u pfulusela ho bvelela nahone tshikhala tshingafhani tsha disiki tshine faela ya kale ya raw ya MongoDB database tshi tshi ḓi shumisa ngomu kha grain, nahone zwi ni tendela u bvisa faela idzo dza raw u itela u vhofholola tshikhala.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb: Faela dza raw dza MongoDB 3 database
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Bvisa faela dza raw dza MongoDB database
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Nga murahu ha u pfulusela ho bvelelaho data i dzula kha FerretDB na kha filesystem, ngauralo faela dza kale dza raw dza MongoDB 3 database dzi nga bviswa u itela u vhofholola tshikhala tsha disiki ya grain. Hezwi a zwi nga vhuyedzwi.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Bvisa faela dza raw dza MongoDB 3 database u itela u vhofholola tshikhala tsha disiki? Data yo no pfuluselwa kha FerretDB na kha filesystem. Hezwi a zwi nga vhuyedzwi.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Faela dza raw dza MongoDB database dzo bviswa, ho vhofhololwa
features-desc: Zwiitwa zwa u ḓinangela zwine WeKan ya zwi ṋea. Tshiitwa tshi songo swaywaho tshi a dzumbiwa kha vhashumisi vhoṱhe. Data yatsho i a vhulungwa nahone thendelo a dzi shanduki.
feature-views-table-desc: Bodo sa thebuḽu ya dzikhadi dzine dza nga tevhekanywa.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Khaḽenda na khaḽenda ya bodo nnzhi.
feature-views-overview-desc: Mbalombalo, u kuvhanganya nga muthu o ṋewaho mushumo, pulane ya mushumo, deshibodo na bodo khulwane.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Nḓila tharu dza u vhona tshati dza Gantt.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Mishumo ya tshibveledzwa yo salaho, zwifhinga zwipfufhi zwa u shuma, muvhigo wa tshifhinga tshenetsho na luvhilo lwa mushumo.
feature-views-flow-charts: Tshati dza u elela ha mishumo
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Mishumo yo salaho, mishumo yo fhelaho, u elela ho kuvhanganywaho, tshifhinga tsha u shuma na tsha u lindela, tshivhalo tsha mishumo yo fhelaho, tshifhinga tshe mishumo ya lindela, zwikhukhulisi, Monte Carlo na zwiṅwe zwipimo zwa u elela ha mishumo.
feature-views-map-desc: Dzikhadi sa zwiga kha tshifanyiso tsho dzheniswaho.
feature-approval-required: Itani uri zwiitwa zwo engedzwaho nga khwiniso dza WeKan zwi si shume u swika mulanguli a tshi zwi tendela
feature-preview-admins: Vhalanguli vha vhona zwiitwa zwo dzimiwaho uri vha zwi linge u thoma
feature-pilot-users: Vhashumisi vha u linga vhane vha dovha vha vhona zwiitwa zwo dzimiwaho
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Madzina a vhashumisi, o khethekanywaho nga khoma
feature-profiles-desc: Phurofaiḽi i dzumba zwiitwa zwo nangiwaho kha vhashumisi, zwigwada na madzangano e ya ṋewa one. Mushumisi u vhudzwa uri u na phurofaiḽi ifhio. A hu na ane a si vhe na phurofaiḽi ane a kwamea, a hu na data i bviswaho nahone a hu na ṱhanganedzo i shandukaho.
feature-profile-teams: Zwigwada, tshithihi kha mutaladzi muṅwe na muṅwe
feature-profile-orgs: Madzangano, ḽithihi kha mutaladzi muṅwe na muṅwe
feature-profile-unknown: Zwo vhulungwa. A zwo ngo wanala:
feature-profile-notice: Phurofaiḽi yaṋu ya zwiitwa __name__ i dzumba zwiitwa zwa __count__. Vhudzisani mulanguli arali ni tshi ṱoḓa tshiṅwe tshazwo.
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Zwo vhulungwa. Madzina aya a vhashumisi ha ngo wanala:
card-field-visibility-desc: Fhethu ha Nzudzanyo dza Bodo / Khadi hune bodo dza kona u hu sumbedza. Fhethu hu songo swaywaho hu dzumbululwa kha khadi iṅwe na iṅwe, khadi ṱhukhu na Nzudzanyo dza Bodo / Khadi dza bodo iṅwe na iṅwe. A hu na data ya khadi kana nzudzanyo ya bodo zwi shandukaho, na u hu swaya hafhu hu sumbedza bodo iṅwe na iṅwe nga he ya vha yo dzudzanywa ngaho. Ndaela ya fhethu ndi ya bodo iṅwe na iṅwe.
cards-loading-auto: Nga u ḓiitela (lazy kha bodo khulwane fhedzi)
cards-loading-description: WeKan i layisha dzikhadi dza bodo nga u ḓiitela: bodo khulwane (i fhiraho mukano wa vhuhulwane) i layisha fhedzi dzikhadi dzi vhonalaho zwino (infinite scroll) na muvhalo u tshilaho, uri i dzule i tshi ṱavhanya nahone i shumise muhumbulo na bandwidth zwiṱuku, ngeno bodo ṱhukhu dzi tshi layisha khadi iṅwe na iṅwe u itela tshenzhemo yo leluwaho, ine zwiitwa zwoṱhe zwa shuma. A hu na zwine zwa tea u dzudzanywa. Vhalanguli vha kha ḓi kona u kombetshedza nḓila nga CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) na CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD environment variables.
cards-loading-lazy-note: U layisha makhadi nga lazy ndi zwa u lingwa: dzikhaunthara dza makhadi na WIP limits ndi dza vhukuma, fhedzi Calendar/Table/Gantt views na multi-select zwi sumbedza fhedzi makhadi o layishwaho u swika zwino. Layisha hafhu mabodo o vulwaho nga murahu ha u shandula hezwi.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Musi zwo vulwa, dzilinki dzoṱhe (zwivhili markdown links dzi ngaho [label](url) na raw HTML <a href> tags) dzi dzula dzi tshi sumbedzwa sa maṅwalwa fhedzi, a dzi puṱedzei kha tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshiṱaka tsha maṅwalwa (dzithero na ṱhalutshedzo dza bodo na khadi, mibono, tshekilisiti, na zwiṅwe). Hezwi zwi thivhela dzilinki dzi xedzaho dzi puṱedzeaho. Nga tshiṱalula zwo dzimwa, ngauralo dzilinki dzi dzula dzi tshi puṱedzea.
always-show-code-as-text: Sumbedza misi yoṱhe khoudu yoṱhe sa maṅwalwa fhedzi
always-show-code-as-text-description: Musi zwo vulwa, maṅwalwa a rich text a hongo sumbedzwa sa markdown kana HTML: tshiko tshoṱhe tshi dzula tshi tshi sumbedzwa sa maṅwalwa fhedzi kha tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshiṱaka tsha maṅwalwa (dzithero na ṱhalutshedzo dza bodo na khadi, mibono, tshekilisiti, na zwiṅwe). Hezwi zwi bvisela khagala zwidzhena zwo dzumbiwaho — HTML comments (<!-- -->), tshine markdown links tsha nanga, JavaScript na iṅwe khoudu iṅwe na iṅwe — ngauralo khoudu yoṱhe i dzula i tshi vhonala, a i puṱedzei, nahone a i shumi. Nga tshiṱalula zwo dzimwa, ngauralo markdown i sumbedzwa nga ho teaho.
disable-all-import-description: Musi zwo vulwa, zwiitwa zwoṱhe zwa u dzhenisa zwi a dzimiwa: u dzhenisa bodo u bva kha WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea na Forgejo, na u kopa bodo. Zwikhetho zwa menyu ya u dzhenisa zwi a dzumbiwa nahone seva i hana khumbelo iṅwe na iṅwe ya u dzhenisa. Nga tshiṱalula zwo dzimwa.
import-max-megabytes-description: Faela khulwane vhukuma ine siaṱari ḽa u dzhenisa ḽa i ṱanganedza, nga megabyte. Hu si na tshithu zwi amba uri a hu na mukano: faela i nga vha khulwane u swika hune fhethu ho vulea kha disiki ha tendela u dzhenisa u fhela. Ṅwalo muṅwe na muṅwe wa u layisha u ṅwalwa kha disiki ya seva tshipiḓa nga tshipiḓa, nahone u dzhenisa hune ha nga ḓadza disiki hu a hanwa.
import-disk-full: A hu na fhethu ho linganaho ho vulea kha disiki ya seva kha u dzhenisa uhu.
import-upload-not-found: Faela yo layishwaho a i tsha vha hone. I nangeni hafhu.
import-upload-failed: Faela a yo ngo kona u layishwa.
disable-all-export-description: Musi zwo vulwa, zwiitwa zwoṱhe zwa u bvisela nnda zwi a dzimiwa: u bvisela nnda bodo sa WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, kana kha NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, na u bvisela nnda tsho namaṱheliswaho tshithihi. Zwikhetho zwa menyu ya u bvisela nnda zwi a dzumbiwa nahone seva i hana khumbelo iṅwe na iṅwe ya u bvisela nnda. Nga tshiṱalula zwo dzimwa.
disable-import-avatars-description: Musi zwo vulwa, avatar (zwifanyiso zwa phurofaela ya vhashumisi) a zwi dzheniswi. Hezwi zwi katela u dzhenisa WeKan JSON, u dzhenisa Trello, na u ṱanganyisa avatar u bva kha vhaṋei vha vhuḓivhi vha nnḓa kha u dzhena (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Madzina na iṅwe data zwi kha ḓi dzheniswa; ndi avatar fhedzi dzi fhiraho. Nga tshiṱalula zwo dzimwa.
disable-export-avatars-description: Musi zwo vulwa, avatar (zwifanyiso zwa phurofaela ya vhashumisi) a zwi katelwi musi u tshi bvisela nnda bodo (WeKan JSON na CSV export). Madzina a vhashumisi na iṅwe data zwi kha ḓi bviselwa nnda; ndi avatar fhedzi dzi siiwaho. Nga tshiṱalula zwo dzimwa.
anonymize-import-users: Dzumba madzina a vhashumisi vha u dzhenisa
anonymize-import-users-description: Musi zwo vulwa, u dzhenisa bodo ḽa WeKan JSON zwi imelela dzina ḽa mushumisi muṅwe na muṅwe o dzheniswaho, dzina ḽoṱhe na maletere a u thoma nga zwiimela zwa muvhalo (user1, user2, ...), zwi bvisa avatar yawe, nahone zwi ṅwala hafhu @username mentions (na masimu a requested-by / assigned-by) ngomu kha zwidzhena zwa khadi na mbono zwo dzheniswaho. A hu na vhuṋe ha mushumisi ha vhukuma u bva kha bodo ḽa tshiko ḽo vhulungwaho. Ipfi "user" ḽi tevhela luambo lwa muthu ane a khou dzhenisa. Nga tshiṱalula zwo dzimwa.
anonymize-export-users: Dzumba madzina a vhashumisi vha u bvisela nnda
anonymize-export-users-description: Musi zwo vulwa, u bvisela nnda bodo zwi imelela dzina ḽa mushumisi muṅwe na muṅwe o bviselwaho nnda, dzina ḽoṱhe na maletere a u thoma nga zwiimela zwa muvhalo (user1, user2, ...), zwi bvisa avatar yawe, nahone zwi ṅwala hafhu @username mentions (na masimu a requested-by / assigned-by) ngomu kha zwidzhena zwa khadi na mbono. Faela yo bviselwaho nnda a i na vhuṋe ha mushumisi ha vhukuma. Ipfi "user" ḽi tevhela luambo lwa muthu ane a khou bvisela nnda. Nga tshiṱalula zwo dzimwa.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Ni na vhuṱanzi ha uri ni ṱoḓa u dzumba vhuṋe ha akhaunthi iyi? Hezwi zwi imelela tshoṱhe dzina ḽa mushumisi, dzina ḽoṱhe na ḓiresi ya imeiḽi nga ndeme dzo dzumbiwaho, zwi bvisa avatar, nahone zwi dzima u dzhena. U sa fana na u bvisa, bodo, dzikhadi na mibono zwi dzula na ḓivhazwakale yazwo nahone zwi kha ḓi sumbedza akhaunthi iyi, fhedzi yo dzumbiwa. Nyito iyi a i koni u humiselwa murahu.
disable-activities-description: Musi zwo vulwa, zwidzhena zwa u phakela mishumo a zwi ṅwaliwi nahone a zwi sumbedzwi naho ngafhi (bara ya bodo na thebe ya mishumo ya khadi). A hu na ḓivhazwakale ha uri ndi nnyi o itaho mini. Nga tshiṱalula zwo dzimwa.
disable-notifications-description: Musi zwo vulwa, WeKan a i rumeli nḓivhadzo dza u ṱhogomela (kha app, imeiḽi kana dziṅwe tshumelo) kha mushumo muṅwe na muṅwe. Mishumo i kha ḓi ṅwaliwa (arali i songo dzimwa nga nṱha); ndi nḓivhadzo fhedzi dzine dza dzimiwa. Nga tshiṱalula zwo dzimwa.
disable-watch-description: Musi zwo vulwa, tshiitwa tsha u lavhelesa tshi a dzimiwa — vhashumisi a vha koni u ṱumela kha mabodo, mitevhe kana makhadi u itela u ṱanganedza zwidivhadzo, nahone lingedzo ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽa u shandula levele ya u lavhelesa ḽi a hanelwa. Nga tshiṱalula zwo dzimwa.
backup-description: Ita bakapu ya Zwo Namaṱheliswaho, Avatar na/kana Data (collections dzoṱhe dza maṅwalwa dzi si dzo namaṱheliswaho kana avatar). .zip i rumelwa nga u ṱavhanya kha vhuvhulungo ho nangiwaho — hu si na faela ya tshifhinganyana — sa backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, i re na YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars na /data. Vhuvhulungo ha cloud (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) vhu shumisa credentials dzo dzudzanywaho kha dzithebe dzavho dza vhuvhulungo.
backup-scope-description: Seva yoṱhe, kana tshiimiswa tshithihi. Bakapu ya tshiimiswa i na dzibodo dzatsho na zwoṱhe zwi re khadzo, na zwiṱaṱisi zwa idzo bodo — fhedzi a hu na akhaunthi dza vhashumisi kana mavhonele a seva, ngauri zwenezwo zwi shumiswa nga zwiimiswa zwoṱhe. U vusulusa bakapu ya tshiimiswa zwi ṅwala fhedzi kha dzibodo dza tshenetsho tshiimiswa.
theme-override-all-tenants: Mavhonele a shumaho kha vhahiri vhoṱhe
continuous-backup: Bakapu i sa vhuyi ya ima
continuous-backup-description: I rumela tshanduko iṅwe na iṅwe ya databeisi, zwo namaṱheliswaho, avatar na rekhodo dza mishumo kha foḽuda nga mithethe i si gathi, uri hu kone u vhuyedzwa kha tshiimo tsha tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe. I shuma khathihi na bakapu yo vhetshelwaho tshifhinga, ine ya ita khophi dzo fhelelaho.
continuous-backup-enabled: Itani bakapu i sa vhuyi ya ima kha seva iyi
continuous-backup-target: Foḽuda ine ha ḓo vhulungwa khayo (nḓila yo fhelelaho, kha disiki iṅwe, vhuvhulungo ho kovhiwaho kha netiweke kana vhuvhulungo ha rclone ho ṱumanywaho)
wekan-data-no-database: A hu na databeisi ya WeKan i vhalaeaho yo wanalaho.
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (nga tshifhinga tshenetsho, tshanduko iṅwe na iṅwe)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Masiaṱari a SQLite (masiaṱari o shandukaho kha tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (mbekanyamushumo ya u tou nanga ine na i dzhenisa)
continuous-backup-engine-none: A hu na nzhini ya databeisi ine ya nga shuma kha seva iyi
continuous-backup-base-every: Khophi ya mutheo ntswa nga murahu ha (awara)
continuous-backup-encrypt: Dzumbani bakapu nga khoudu ya tshiphiri (AES-256-GCM)
continuous-backup-key-file: Faela ya khii ya khoudu ya tshiphiri (nḓila yo fhelelaho nnḓa ha foḽuda ine ha ḓo vhulungwa khayo; zwiga zwa 64 zwa maitele a nomboro a mutheo wa 16 kana mubulo wa tshiphiri une wa vha na zwiga zwa 16 kana u fhira). Vhulungani khophi: arali faela iyi i siho, bakapu i nga si vhuyiselwe.
continuous-backup-upload-none: A hu na fhethu (kha foḽuda ine ha ḓo vhulungwa khayo fhedzi)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Foḽuda ngomu ha tshifaredzi tsha u vhulunga
continuous-backup-litestream-binary: Faela ya mbekanyamushumo ya Litestream (nḓila yo fhelelaho)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Faela ya databeisi ya SQLite (i fhaṱiwa tsini na bakapu, a i ṅwali na luthihi nṱha ha faela ine ya khou shumiswa)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Shumisani databeisi ya SQLite yo fhaṱululwaho musi sisiteme i tshi thoma hafhu nga tshifhinga tshi tevhelaho (databeisi ya kale yo dzhielwaho vhudzulo i ḓo vhulungwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Vhuyedzani murafho wo nangiwaho kha tshifhinga tsho nangiwaho? Bakapu i sa vhuyi ya ima i ḓo ima lwa tshifhinganyana musi u vhuyedza hu tshi khou bvela phanḓa.
continuous-backup-saved: Nzudzanyo dza bakapu i sa vhuyi ya ima dzo vhulungwa
backup-restore-select-first: Nanga bakapu u bva kha mutevhe u thoma.
backup-restore-confirm: Vhuyedza bakapu yo nangiwaho? Zwo namaṱheliswaho/avatar zwi ṅwalwa kha filesystem nahone data kha database u ya nga modo yo nangiwaho.
gcs-key-filename: Nḓila ya faela ya khii ya service account
gcs-key-filename-description: A zwi ṱhogei: nḓila ya faela ya khii ya JSON ya service account kha seva.
gcs-credentials-description: A zwi ṱhogei: nambatedza khii ya JSON ya service account. Sia hu si na tshithu u itela u shumisa faela ya khii kana credentials dza tshiṱalula.
gcs-permissions-note: Ṋea service account ya WeKan pfanelo ya u vhala/u ṅwala kha bucket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → bucket yaṋu → Permissions → Grant access. Kha "New principals", nambatedza email ya service account — vhuci ha "client_email" u bva kha khii yaṋu ya JSON — nga zwenezwo nanga mushumo "Storage Object Admin" nahone Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Sia hu si na tshithu u itela u dzula na vhuci ha zwino.
azure-account-name-description: Dzina ḽa akhaunthi yaṋu ya Azure Storage.
azure-container-description: Blob container ya u vhulunga faela.
gcs-project-id-description: Project id yaṋu ya Google Cloud.
gcs-bucket-description: Dzina ḽa bucket ya Cloud Storage ya u vhulunga faela.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: sia hu si na tshithu (i shumisa endpoint ya vundu). S3-compatible: Endpoint URL u bva kha console yaṋu ya MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → bucket yaṋu → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → dzina ḽa bucket yaṋu (kana Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → mushumisi waṋu → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → nanga use case 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Yo sumbedzwaho sa 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Tshikirini tshi fanaho na Access key ID; 'Secret access key' i sumbedzwa luthihi fhedzi musi khii i tshi sikwa — i kopolole nga tshenetsho tshifhinga (kana Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaunthi yaṋu → dzina ḽo sumbedzwaho nṱha (na fhasi ha Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaunthi yaṋu → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaunthi yaṋu → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaunthi yaṋu → Data storage → Containers → container yaṋu (kana + Container u sika iṅwe).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → project selector nṱha → ID ya project yaṋu (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → dzina ḽa bucket yaṋu (kana Create u sika iṅwe).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Nḓila kha seva ya WeKan ya faela ya khii ya JSON ya service account yo downloadwaho (yo sikwaho nga fhasi). Shumisa hezwi KANA nambatedza JSON kha tshiṱaka nga fhasi.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → service account yaṋu → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (i downloada faela). Nambatedza zwidzhena zwayo fhano, kana vhulunga faela nahone vhea nḓila yayo nṱha.
cloud-secret-set: (yo vhulungwa — sia hu si na tshithu u dzula nayo)
cloud-settings-save-failed: Zwo kundelwa u vhulunga nzudzanyo ya vhuvhulungo
cloud-settings-desc: Nga WeKan kha Weddy, Cloud Panel i shumela domeini nnzhi dza WeKan u bva kha seva nthihi, iṅwe na iṅwe i na data yayo. Kha domeini ya Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin u langa domeini na CloudFlare.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel ndi ya SuperAdmin fhedzi, kha domeini ya Cloud Panel.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Nga khii ya CloudFlare API, domeini ine zone yayo ya vha kha akhaunthi yaṋu ya CloudFlare i wana rekhodo ya DNS ya proxy na thanziela ya CloudFlare Origin. Dziṅwe domeini dzi wana thanziela ya Let's Encrypt. Khii i vhulungwa kha seva nahone a i tsha sumbedzwa hu ḽa.
cloudflare-api-key-set: Khii ya CloudFlare API yo vhulungwa.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: A hu na khii ya CloudFlare API yo vhulungwaho: domeini iṅwe na iṅwe i wana thanziela ya Let's Encrypt.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Pfukisela tsho namaṱheliswaho kha Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Pfukisela tsho namaṱheliswaho kha Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Shumisa MongoDB GridFS u vhulunga faela
migration-pausing: I khou imisa u pfulusa lwa tshifhinganyana...
migration-pause-failed: U imisa u pfulusa lwa tshifhinganyana zwo kundelwa
migration-paused: U pfulusa ho imiswa lwa tshifhinganyana nga nḓila yo bvelelaho
migration-start-failed: U thoma u pfulusa zwo kundelwa
migration-started: U pfulusa ho thoma nga nḓila yo bvelelaho
migration-not-needed: A hu na u pfulusa hu ṱoḓeaho
migration-stop-confirm: Ni na vhuṱanzi ha uri ni ṱoḓa u imisa u pfulusa hoṱhe?
migration-stop-failed: U imisa u pfulusa zwo kundelwa
migration-stopped: U pfulusa ho imiswa nga nḓila yo bvelelaho
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: U itela uri zwo namaṱheliswaho na avatar zwi vhonale, zwi pfukisele u bva kha CollectionFS u ya kha vhuṅwe Vhuvhulungo naho vhufhio.
pause-all-migrations: Imisa u pfulusa hoṱhe lwa tshifhinganyana
s3-access-key: Khii ya u dzhena ya S3
s3-access-key-description: Khii ya u dzhena ya AWS S3 ya u khwaṱhisedza mushumisi
s3-access-key-placeholder: Ṅwalani khii ya u dzhena ya S3
s3-bucket-description: Dzina ḽa bucket ya S3 ya u vhulunga faela

s3-port-description: Nomboro ya phothe ya fhethu ha u ṱumanya S3
s3-secret-key-description: Khii ya tshiphiri ya AWS S3 ya u khwaṱhisedza mushumisi
s3-secret-key-placeholder: Ṅwalani khii ya tshiphiri ya S3
s3-secret-key-required: Hu ṱoḓea khii ya tshiphiri ya S3
s3-settings-save-failed: U vhulunga nzudzanyo dza S3 zwo kundelwa
s3-settings-saved: Nzudzanyo dza S3 dzo vhulungwa nga nḓila yo bvelelaho
s3-ssl-enabled-description: Shumisa SSL/TLS kha u ṱumanya S3
schedule-board-archive: Dzudzanya u vhulunga bodo ya Kanban
schedule-board-backup: Dzudzanya khophi ya tsireledzo ya bodo
scheduled-board-operations: Nyito dza bodo ya Kanban dzo dzudzanywaho
writable-path-description: Nḓila ya foldara ya mutheo ya u vhulunga faela
comprehensive-board-migration: U pfulusa bodo ya Kanban nga vhuḓalo
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: I sedza na u lugisa vhungoho ha data ya bodo ya Kanban nga vhuḓalo, hu tshi katelwa mutevhe wa mitevhe, fhethu ha makhadi na nzudzanyo ya dziḽaini.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration: Bvisa mitevhe yo dovhololwaho i si na tshithu
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: I bvisa mitevhe yo dovhololwaho i si na tshithu nga nḓila yo tsireledzeaho. I bvisa fhedzi mitevhe i si na makhadi NA ine ya vha na muṅwe mutevhe wa dzina ḽithihi une wa vha na makhadi.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: I wana na u vhuyedzedza makhadi na mitevhe i si na swimlaneId kana listId. I sika ḽaini ya 'Lost Cards' u ita uri zwithu zwoṱhe zwo xelaho zwi vhonale hafhu.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: I vhuyedzedza dziḽaini, mitevhe na makhadi zwoṱhe zwo vhulungwaho. I lugisa swimlaneId kana listId i siho nga yoṱhe u ita uri zwithu zwi vhonale.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: I wana na u lugisa mitevhe i siho kana yo tshinyalaho kha nzudzanyo ya bodo ya Kanban.
fix-avatar-urls-migration: Lugisa URL dza zwifanyiso zwa vhashumisi
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: I shandula URL dza zwifanyiso zwa miraḓo ya bodo ya Kanban u shumisa nḓila yo teaho ya u vhulunga, ya lugisa zwine zwa sumba kha zwifanyiso zwo tshinyalaho.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: I shandula URL dzoṱhe dza ṱumetshedzo dza faela kha bodo iyi ya Kanban u shumisa nḓila yo teaho ya u vhulunga, ya lugisa zwine zwa sumba kha faela zwo tshinyalaho.
migration-successful: U pfulusa ho fhela nga nḓila yo bvelelaho
migrations-admin-only: Ndi vhalanguli vha bodo ya Kanban fhedzi vhane vha nga thoma u pfulusa
migrations-description: Sedzani na u lugisa vhungoho ha data ya bodo iyi ya Kanban. U pfulusa huṅwe na huṅwe hu nga itwa nga huṱhe.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Izwi zwi ḓo pfulusa nga vhuḓalo u sedza na u lugisa vhungoho ha data ya bodo ya Kanban. Zwi nga dzhia tshifhinganyana. Bvela phanḓa?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Izwi zwi ḓo thoma zwa shandula mitevhe yo kovhiwaho ya vha mitevhe ya ḽaini iṅwe na iṅwe, zwa kona u bvisa mitevhe i si na tshithu ine ya vha na muṅwe mutevhe wa dzina ḽithihi u re na makhadi. Hu ḓo bviswa fhedzi mitevhe i si na tshithu i sa ṱoḓei zwa vhukuma. Bvela phanḓa?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Izwi zwi ḓo sika ḽaini ya 'Lost Cards' zwa vhuyedzedza makhadi oṱhe na mitevhe i si na swimlaneId kana listId. Izwi zwi kwama fhedzi zwithu zwi sa athu vhulungwa. Bvela phanḓa?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Izwi zwi ḓo vhuyedzedza dziḽaini, mitevhe na makhadi ZWOṰHE zwo vhulungwaho u zwi ita uri zwi vhonale hafhu. Zwithu zwi si na ID zwi ḓo lugiswa nga zwoṱhe. Izwi a zwi koni u humiselwa murahu nga hu leluwaho. Bvela phanḓa?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Izwi zwi ḓo wana na u lugisa mitevhe i siho kana yo tshinyalaho kha nzudzanyo ya bodo ya Kanban. Bvela phanḓa?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Izwi zwi ḓo shandula URL dza zwifanyiso zwa miraḓo ya bodo ya Kanban u shumisa nḓila yo teaho ya u vhulunga. Bvela phanḓa?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Izwi zwi ḓo shandula URL dzoṱhe dza ṱumetshedzo dza faela kha bodo iyi ya Kanban u shumisa nḓila yo teaho ya u vhulunga. Bvela phanḓa?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: A hu na dziḽaini, mitevhe kana makhadi o xelaho a u vhuyedzedza
migration-progress-title: U pfulusa bodo ya Kanban hu khou bvela phanḓa
migration-progress-note: Lindelani musi ri tshi pfulusela bodo yaṋu ya Kanban kha nzudzanyo ya zwino...
step-fix-orphaned-cards: Lugisa makhadi a si na mubebi
step-ensure-per-swimlane-lists: Khwaṱhisedzani mitevhe ya ḽaini iṅwe na iṅwe
step-fix-avatar-urls: Lugisa URL dza zwifanyiso zwa vhashumisi
step-delete-duplicate-empty-lists: Bvisani mitevhe i si na tshithu yo dovhololwaho
step-ensure-lost-cards-swimlane: Ita uri ḽaini ya makhadi o xelaho i vhe hone
step-scan-users: U sedza zwifanyiso zwa miraḓo ya bodo
step-scan-files: U sedza ṱumetshedzo dza faela dza bodo ya Kanban
conversion-info-text: Tshanduko iyi i itwa luthihi kha bodo iṅwe na iṅwe ya Kanban nahone i khwinisa mashumele. Ni nga bvela phanḓa ni tshi shumisa bodo nga nḓila ya nga misi.
converting-board-description: I khou shandula nzudzanyo ya bodo ya Kanban u khwinisa mashumele. Izwi zwi nga dzhia tshifhinganyana.
every-1-minute: Nga murahu ha minetse muṅwe na muṅwe
every-30-minutes: Nga murahu ha minetse ya 30 iṅwe na iṅwe
export-monitoring: Bvisela nnḓa data ya u tevhela
filesystem-storage: U vhulunga kha sisiteme ya faela
idle-migration: U pfulusa hu sa khou shuma
max-concurrent: Tshivhalo tshihulwanesa tshi shumaho nga tshifhinga tshithihi
migrate-all-to-filesystem: Pfulusela zwoṱhe kha sisiteme ya faela
migration-batch-size-description: Tshivhalo tsha ṱumetshedzo dza u shuma kha tshigwada tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Imisa u pfulusa lwa tshifhinganyana musi u shumiswa ha CPU hu tshi fhira phesenthe iyi (10-90)
migration-delay-ms-description: Tshifhinga tsha u lindela vhukati ha zwigwada nga miḽisekonde (100-10000)
migration-info-text: U pfulusa database hu itwa luthihi nahone hu khwinisa mashumele a sisiteme. Mushumo u bvela phanḓa murahu naho no vala burauza yaṋu.
migration-resume-failed: U thomisa u pfulusa hafhu zwo kundelwa
migration-warning-text: Ni songo vala burauza yaṋu musi hu tshi pfuluswa. Mushumo u ḓo bvela phanḓa murahu fhedzi u nga dzhia tshifhinga tshilapfu u fhela.
monitoring-export-failed: U bvisa data ya u tevhela zwo kundelwa
monitoring-refresh-failed: U ḽouda data ya u tevhela hafhu zwo kundelwa
search-boards-or-operations: Ṱoḓa bodo dza Kanban kana nyito...
showChecklistAtMinicard: Sumbedza mutevhe wa u sedza kha khadi ḽiṱuku
storage-distribution: U phaḓaladzwa ha fhethu ha u vhulunga
already-account: No no vha na akhaunthi? Dzhenani
available-repositories: Zwivhulungi zwa khoudu zwi re hone
no-repositories: A hu ngo wanala fhethu ha khoudu
sign-in-to-upload: Dzhena u itela u rumela zwivhulungi zwa khoudu
account-locked: Akhaunthi yo valelwa lwa tshifhinganyana nga u kundelwa u dzhena lunzhi. Lingedzani hafhu nga murahu.
invalid-credentials: Dzina ḽa mushumisi kana phasiwede a zwi ngo tea
username-password-required: Dzina ḽa mushumisi na phasiwede zwi a ṱoḓea
username-too-short: Dzina ḽa mushumisi ḽi tea u vha na zwiga zwi si fhasi ha 3

map-view-empty: Iyi bodo a i athu u vha na tshifanyiso tsha mepe. Mulanguli wa bodo a nga layisha tshifanyiso — pulane ya fuloro, mepe wa fhethu kana tshifanyiso tsho oliwaho — nga murahu dzikhadi dza vhewa khatsho.

flow-note-agingWip: Makhadi o vulwaho: maḓuvha u bva musi a tshi dzhena kha tshiṱepe tsha zwino. Bara tswuku dzi fhira phesenthaiḽi ya 85 ya ḓivhazwakale yatsho (hu si fhasi ha u dzula hu ṱanu). Ḓivhazwakale ya u dzhena i siho a i ḓivhei.
flow-note-blockerAnalysis: Ḓivhazwakale ya zwiḓitiki i ṋea tshifhinga tsha u thoma na tsha u fhela tsha zwi thivhelaho kha tshiṱepe tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe. Vhuṱumani ha kale vhu nga vha vhu si na mathomo a ḓivheaho. Makhadi o bviswaho a ṱoḓa zwifanyiso zwa ḓivhazwakale zwo vhulungwaho. Zwiitisi zwi dzhenelanaho zwi vhalwa zwo fhambana.
flow-note-monteCarlo: Ndingo dza 2,000 dzi nanga maḓuvha o fhelelaho a khalenda ya UTC, hu tshi katelwa maḓuvha a si na mushumo wo fhelaho. Maḓuvha ndi nyanganyelo dza tshipiḓa tsha nṱha; zwivhalo ndi u ḓiimisela ha tshipiḓa tsha fhasi. Zwi humbulela uri mushumo u ḓo fhela nga nḓila i fanaho; a si khwaṱhisedzo. Mukano muhulwane: maḓuvha a 3,650. Arali hu si na mushumo wo fhelaho, a hu na nyanganyelo.
flow-note-processBehavior: Tshifhinga tsha tshiimo tshi shumisa Mathomo, kana ḓuvha ḽa u sikwa arali a siho, na Magumo, kana u vhulungwa arali a siho. XmR i sumbedza ndeme nthihi nthihi na phambano dzi tevhekanaho, na vhukati na mikano ya mvelo ya mashumele; hu ṱoḓea mishumo i si fhasi ha mivhili yo fhelaho nga nḓila yo teaho.
flow-note-sizeCycleTime: Nyanganyelo ya zwino ya Planning Poker kana fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho ha nomboro, zwi tshi vhambedzwa na tshifhinga tsha tshiimo tsho fhelaho nga maḓuvha. Nyanganyelo dzi siho na maḓuvha a songo teaho a a litshwa. Arali hu si na mathomo, hu shumiswa ḓuvha ḽa u sikwa; arali hu si na magumo, hu shumiswa u vhulungwa.

r-blocks-help: Ṱumanyani tshithomi tshithihi na nyito nthihi. Kokodzani bulogo u bva kha bogisi ḽa zwishumiswa. Shumisani editha ya fomo kha khetho dza nṱha.
r-blocks-discard: Laṱa tshanduko dza bulogo dzi songo vhulungwaho?
r-blocks-unavailable: Data ya mulayo a i wanali. Shumisani editha ya fomo u sedza mulayo uyu.
r-blocks-invalid: Ṱumanyani tshithomi tshithihi fhedzi na nyito nthihi. Bvisani bulogo dzi songo ṱumanywaho kana dzo engedzeaho ni sa athu vhulunga.
r-blocks-conflict: Mulayo uyu wo shanduka musi ni tshi khou u lulamisa. Ḽoudani hafhu mulayo wo vhulungwaho ni sa athu vhulunga.
r-blocks-permission: Thendelo ya mulanguli wa bodo i a ṱoḓea u lulamisa milayo.
scrum-source-customField: Fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho ha nomboro
scrum-policy-dueComplete: Khadi yo swaywa sa yo fhela
scrum-policy-doneLists: Khadi kha mutevhe wa khethekanyo ya Zwo itwa
scrum-rollover-sprint: Pfulusa mushumo u songo fhelaho u ye kha
scrum-edit-sprint: Ita kana lulamisa sprint yo dzudzanywaho
scrum-release-scope: Khadi dzi re kha khanḓiso iyi
scrum-releases-select-help: Khadi i nga vha kha khanḓiso nnzhi. Farani Ctrl (Cmd kha Mac) u nanga u fhira nthihi; dzi bviseni dzoṱhe u bvisa khadi kha khanḓiso iṅwe na iṅwe.
scrum-select-sprint: Nangani sprint u vhona muvhigo wayo.
scrum-backlog-help: Dzudzanyani mushumo nga vhuimo ha mishumo yo salaho. Avhelani khadi kha sprint yo dzudzanywaho kana i shumaho.
scrum-event-daily: Scrum ya Ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe
scrum-no-closed-sprints: A hu na tshifanyiso tsha sprint yo valwaho tshi wanalaho.
scrum-report-help: Mivhigo i vhulunga khakhathelo u bva kha zwifanyiso zwa sprint. Khakhathelo dzi sa ḓivhiwi dzi vhalwa dzo khethekana; a si khakhathelo dza ziro. Vhambedzani tshihaḓu fhedzi kha yuniti dza khakhathelo na mbekanyamaitele zwi fanaho.
scrum-total: Khadi dza __count__; __estimate__ dzo khakhathelwa; __unknown__ a dzi ḓivhiwi
scrum-confirm-close: Vala sprint iyi ni vhulunge mvelelo dzayo? Khadi dzi songo fhelaho dzi ḓo pfuluselwa kha fhethu ho nangwaho.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Khansela sprint iyi? Khadi dzayo dzi ḓo dzula dzi tshi vha dzayo u swika dzi tshi avhelwa hafhu.
scrum-partial-report: Muvhigo wa tshipiḓa: ho katelwa khadi dzo avhelwaho inwi zwino fhedzi.
scrum-import-reference-omitted: Tshiṱoḓwa tsha tshisima a tsho ngo kona u vhuiswa: __reference__
scrum-partial-snapshot: Sprint iyi i na tshipiḓa fhedzi tsha tshifanyiso tsha u thoma.
scrum-resume-close: Bvelaphanḓa na u vala sprint ho kanganyedzwaho
scrum-rollover-progress: U tshimbidzela khadi dza sprint phanḓa: __done__ kha __total__
scrum-history-job-running: U humisela murahu kana u dovha u ita tshanduko khulwane: __done__ kha mitaladzi ya ḓivhazwakale ya __total__
scrum-history-job-failed: U humisela murahu kana u dovha u ita tshanduko khulwane zwo ima. Dovha u puṱedze humisela murahu kana dovha u ite uri u bvele phanḓa:
scrum-daily-observations: Tshikalo tsha ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe na mushumo wo salaho (zwo vhonwaho)
scrum-daily-observations-help: Bara iṅwe na iṅwe i sumbedza zwo vhonwaho zwa u thoma zwo rekhodiwaho zwa ḓuvha ḽa UTC, kha tshifhinga tsho sumbedzwaho. Maḓuvha a si ho a sa sumbedzwi. Zwo vhonwaho izwi a zwi rekhodi tshanduko iṅwe na iṅwe kana u sumbedza tshanganyelo tsha magumo a ḓuvha. Khakhathelo dzi sa ḓivhiwi a si ziro. Shumisani nyito ya Export ya tshipiḓa itshi kha zwo vhonwaho zwa ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe; nyito ya Export ya bara ya zwishumiswa i bvisela nnḓa mvelelo dza sprint.
scrum-daily-truncated: Ho sumbedzwa zwo vhonwaho zwa 366 zwa zwino fhedzi.
scrum-daily-empty: A hu na zwo vhonwaho zwa ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe zwo rekhodiwaho kha sprint iyi.
scrum-scope-history: Vhuhulu ha mushumo na mushumo wo salaho, tshanduko nga tshanduko
scrum-scope-history-help: Zwo fhaṱululwa zwi tshi bva kha ḓivhazwakale ya bodo u bva musi tshifhinga tsha mushumo tshi tshi thoma: mutaladzi muthihi wa tshanduko iṅwe na iṅwe kha khadi dza tshifhinga tsha mushumo, nyanganyelo kana mushumo wo fhelaho.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Ḓivhazwakale a i bveledzi hafhu tshifanyiso tsha vhuimo ha tshifhinga itshi tsha mushumo nga tshoṱhe: dziṅwe tshanduko dzo itwa dzi songo ṅwalwa kha ḓivhazwakale, ngauralo ndeme idzi a yo ngo fhelela.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Ho vhalwa fhedzi tshanduko dza u thoma; u fhaṱulula a ho ngo fhelela.
scrum-scope-history-empty: A hu na tshanduko u bva musi tshifhinga tsha mushumo tshi tshi thoma.
scrum-scope-cause-scrum: U vha tshipiḓa tsha tshifhinga tsha mushumo zwo shanduka
scrum-scope-cause-dates: Vhuimo ha u fhedza ho shanduka
scrum-scope-cause-lifecycle: Khadi yo vhulungwa kha vhuvhulunzwi kana yo vhuyiselwa
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Zwo vhonwaho zwa u thoma zwo rekhodiwaho zwa ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽa UTC; maḓuvha a si ho a sa sumbedzwi. Zwo vhonwaho a zwi rekhodi tshanduko iṅwe na iṅwe kana tshanganyelo tsha magumo a ḓuvha. Khakhathelo dzi sa ḓivhiwi a si ziro.
scrum-import-pending: U dzhenisa ha Scrum a ho ngo fhela. U lulamisa ha Scrum na u bvisela nnḓa mivhigo a zwi wanali.
scrum-import-discard: Fhelisani u dzhenisa hu sa athu fhela
scrum-import-recovery-hint: U dzhenisa ho khakhiswaho nga u thoma hafhu hu nga fhedziswa hafha musi ho no ima. Arali pulane yaho i songo vhulungwa yoṱhe, hu nga fheliswa fhedzi; izwi a zwi shanduli tshithu kha bodo.
scrum-import-into-board: Dzhenisa u dzudzanya ha Scrum kha bodo iyi
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Nangani faela ya u bvisela nnḓa bodo ya WeKan kana faela ya u pfukisa ya Scrum. Dzisprint na khanḓiso dzine bodo iyi ya vha nadzo dzi a ṱumanywa, a dzi dovhololwi. Khadi dzi elaniswa nga ID, kana nga nomboro ya khadi na ṱhoho; khadi dzi sa elani dzi a ṅwalwa dza siiwa dzi songo shandukiswa. Sedzani u thoma u vhona zwine zwa ḓo shanduka.
scrum-import-invalid-file: Faela iyi a si JSON yo teaho.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Dzisprint: __created__ ntswa, __matched__ dzo no vha kha bodo iyi, __skipped__ a dzo ngo dzheniswa
scrum-import-preview-releases: Khanḓiso: __created__ ntswa, __matched__ dzo no vha kha bodo iyi, __skipped__ a dzo ngo dzheniswa
scrum-import-preview-cards: Khadi: __updated__ dza u khwinisa, __unchanged__ a dzo ngo shanduka, __unmatched__ a dzo ngo elana
scrum-import-preview-nothing: A hu na zwa u shandukisa: bodo iyi yo no vha na u dzudzanya uhu.
scrum-import-into-board-done: U dzudzanya ha Scrum ho dzheniswa ha rekhodiwa kha Ḓivhazwakale.
scrum-import-card-not-matched: Khadi a yo ngo wanala kha bodo iyi: __reference__
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Khadi i elana na khadi i fhiraho nthihi kha bodo iyi: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Khadi ndi ya iṅwe bodo ya siiwa i songo shandukiswa: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: Sprint kana khanḓiso i elana na i fhiraho nthihi kha bodo iyi: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: Sprint, khanḓiso kana tshiitea a zwo ngo kona u dzheniswa: __reference__
scrum-import-sprint-finished: Khadi a yo ngo pfuluselwa kha sprint yo fhelaho: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Nangani ndeme kha khanedzano iṅwe na iṅwe. Sync i lingedza hafhu nga murahu ha khetho iṅwe na iṅwe. A hu na tshi rumelwaho kha sisiteme ya tshisima.
sync-conflict-refresh: Shumisani Sync hafhu u sedzulusa ndeme dza zwino.
